name: CoQA: Conversational Question Answering Challenge
description: CoQA is a large-scale conversational question answering dataset containing 127,000+ questions with answers from 8,399 conversations across seven diverse domains (children's stories, literature, news, Wikipedia, school exams, Reddit, and science). Unlike standard extractive QA, answers can be free-form text supported by rationale text spans.
